name: Per-row cross-entropy
description: Per-row cross-entropy loss (no reduction): out[m] = logsumexp(logits[m, :]) - logits[m, target[m]]. target is int64 in [0, V). Output shape [M], float32.
signature: run(logits: Tensor[M, V], target: Tensor[M] (int64)) -> Tensor[M]
provenance: Original KernelRL task (written from scratch). Task category inspired by KernelBench level 2 (github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench, MIT license); no KernelBench code copied.
